svg.text: Figure 9: Distributional Boxplots & Jittered Scatter — By Model and Writing Domain
Boxes show Median & IQR (25th–75th percentile); whiskers show 10th–90th percentile; dots show individual documents (N = 600)
A. Initial Watermark Z-Score Distribution by Model (N = 200 each)
B. Document Mean Post-Attack Z-Score by Writing Domain (N = 150 each)
